name: libreharness
description: A durable task queue and engineering workflow for OpenCode, as a plugin.

scripts.test:node: node tests/auto-intake.test.mjs && node tests/goal-watch.test.mjs && node tests/usage-ledger.test.mjs && node tests/structural.test.mjs && node tests/comment-audit-entrypoint.test.mjs && node tests/plugin.test.mjs && node tests/harness-ratchets.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
scripts.check:syntax: python3 -m compileall -q bin tests && node --check src/plugin.js && node --check plugins/auto-intake.js && node --check plugins/goal-watch.js && node --check plugins/usage-ledger.js && python3 -m json.tool package.json >/dev/null
scripts.lint:shell: find . -name '*.sh' -not -path './node_modules/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -r python3 bin/devtool.py run shellcheck -x
scripts.check:local: npm run tools:install && npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run lint:comments && npm pack --dry-run && npm run lint:md && npm run lint:links && npm run lint:secrets && npm run lint:shell && npm run lint:workflows
